I have enough information now. Here's the diagnosis:

---

## Build Failure Analysis

### Solution Structure
```
BuildDiag.sln
├── Core (Core.csproj) — net8.0 class library
├── Services (Services.csproj) — net8.0 class library, depends on Core
└── Api (Api.csproj) — net8.0 exe, depends on Services + Core
```

### Root Cause Error (1 issue, 3 error messages)

**Project:** `Services/Services.csproj`  
**File:** `Services/UserService.cs`

| Error | Location | Message |
|-------|----------|---------|
| CS0246 | Line 2, Col 7 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | Line 3, Col 7 | `'Newtonsoft'` namespace not found |
| CS0246 | Line 22, Col 19 | `'JObject'` type not found |

**Diagnosis:** `UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (likely `using Newtonsoft.Json;` and `using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;`), but `Services.csproj` has **no `<PackageReference>` for `Newtonsoft.Json`**. The project only declares a `<ProjectReference>` to `Core.csproj` and a `<Compile>` item.

### Cascading Failure

**Project:** `Api/Api.csproj`  
The Api project references Services. Because Services failed to compile, Api could not resolve its dependency and did not reach its own `CoreCompile` step. **This is not an independent error** — it will resolve once Services builds successfully.

### Fix

Add the missing NuGet package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <ProjectReference Include="..\Core\Core.csproj" />
</ItemGroup>

<!-- Add this ItemGroup -->
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

This single fix resolves all 3 compiler errors and unblocks the Api project build.
